entities.summary: Hazret Medzhidovich Sovmen was the second president of the Republic of Adygea, Russia, having succeeded Aslan Dzharimov at the post. Sovmen is a university professor from Maykop. Before becoming President, Hazret Sovmen had been a successful businessman, having started off as a bulldozer driver in a gold mine in Chukotka. He is the founder of Polyus Gold, Russia's leading gold-mining company. Hazret Sovmen was a performers & entertainers from Afipsip (b. 1937-05-01, Afipsip). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
